title.zh: 性能：卷帘 ghost 层与 Explore 列表
title.en: Performance: the roll's ghost layer, and the Explore list

highlights.zh: PianoRollLane 的循环 ghost 层不再逐音符扫描全部音符，改问已建索引：768 音符 585→25 ms、1500 音符 1572→48 ms，结果逐一相同。
highlights.en: The roll's looped ghost layer no longer scans every note per ghost note but asks the index it already builds: 768 notes 585 to 25 ms, 1500 notes 1572 to 48 ms, with identical results.

highlights.zh: Explore 列表改为增量窗口：159→24 张卡、DOM 6495→1095 节点、中位渲染 800→151 ms；分组计数仍读全量，稳态终值不变。
highlights.en: The Explore list now windows its cards: 159 to 24 on first paint, 6495 to 1095 DOM nodes, median render 800 to 151 ms; group counts still read the full list and the steady state is unchanged.
